To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the application of nutrients in the rhizoboxes increased the abundance and expression levels of CYP153 genes and the abundance of the alkane degrading bacteria Pantoea sp., in the rhizospheres of ryegrass grown in diesel-contaminate soil, and thus enhanced hydrocarbon degradation.
the combined application of nutrients with plant and inoculum can be a promising strategy for enhancing the survival and metabolic activities of the rhizo-bacter in the rhizospheric environment.

the combination between annual ryegrass, inoculation with alkane-degrading bacteria and the addition of nutrients to the contaminated soil is an efficient approach to remediate diesel-contaminated agricultural land.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of plant growth promoting bacteria on the growth and hydrocarbon mineralisation by ryegrass planted in hydrocarbon-polluted soil.
the development of a new technology for the remediation hydrocarbons in soil.
the use of rhizo-bacteria to enhance the remediation of contaminated soil.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination between plant, inoculation and nutrients amendment can be used for remediation of hydrocarbon polluted soils.
the combination between plant, inoculated pollutant-degrading bacterium and nutrients amendment is an efficient approach for hydrocarbon removal in contaminated soil.
the combination between ryegrass, inoculum and nutrients was efficient for the remediation hydrocarbon contaminated soil.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
nutrients can enhance the abundance and expression CYP153 gene of alkane hydroxylase in the rhizoplane of ryegrass planted in hydrocarbon-polluted soil.
the combination of vegetation, inoculation and nutrient amendment can improve the degradation of pollutants in the environment.
nutrient addition enhanced the abundance and expression level of the alkane hydroxylase Cyp153 gene in the ryegrass rhizosphere.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nutrients play a crucial role in enhancing plant-bacteria partnership for the remediation process.
the combined application of plant inoculums and nutrients can be a successful approach for hydrocarbon bioremediation in soil and water.
the combined use of plant and bacterial inoculation with nutrient amendment can be an efficient approach for the remediation hydrocarbon contaminated soils.
